invariant: GraphvizImageBuilder mutates a directly empty package group to EMPTY_PACKAGE. For an ordinary package with no explicit USymbol, GeneralImageBuilder selects EntityImageEmptyPackage. EntityImageEmptyPackage.calculateDimensionSlow first fixes the leaf size from the package title/stereotype blocks and its own 10-pixel margins. Its drawU then constructs ClusterDecoration with that fixed RectangleArea, getSkinParam().packageStyle(), and a null symbol, so ClusterDecoration.guess applies the configured packageStyle only to asBig paint geometry. The package-title style, dimensions, UID, and direct unwrapped emission remain those of EntityImageEmptyPackage.
causal_divergence: Rust initially restricted empty-leaf symbol_kind to automatic_package_kind, based on the predecessor account's false assumption that packageStyle affected clusters only. The independent checker generated a valid ordinary directly empty package under packageStyle cloud: Java paints a cloud in the ordinary empty-package rectangle while Rust keeps folder chrome. The first implementation reached the cloud but incorrectly reused explicit-USymbol asSmall margins and entity-wrapper emission, changing the layout seed and document structure.
planned_change: For directly empty ordinary package leaves, select paint geometry from automatic_package_kind first and configured_package_kind second, matching ClusterDecoration.guess. Keep EntityImageEmptyPackage's package-title measurement, 10-pixel dimensions, package semantic style lookup, direct unwrapped emission, and original package UID. Explicit-USymbol leaves continue through their distinct EntityImageDescription/asSmall sizing and wrapper path.
